analysis:
Examined the ProviderLoop.swift head excerpts (lines 543-1134) and the two new test files. The only production-source change in this batch is in ProviderLoop.swift, around lines 342-371, which the patch excerpt shows: autopilotHistory now stores a labeled tuple with a new `detail` field, and new in-memory autopilot state is added (autopilotAdoptedModelIDs, autopilotHolds, autopilotBusyClock, transitionWatchdog, autopilotStalledCommandId, startupPreloadStopRequested, resliceGateGeneration). Those lines are outside the supplied numbered units, so the stored-property additions are visible only through the patch excerpt. The supplied numbered text (init, ModelSlot, the E2E key pair NodeKeyPair.generate() at line 851, the attestation signer) looks unchanged and consistent with A-003, A-002 and TB-003. The added tests cover the behaviour of the new feature: an adopted inventory model keeps serving after the lease ends, adoption and holds are cleared on every basis end (unload, consent revoked, disabled, deselected, self-test failed, retiring, hash unavailable, shutdown), unadopted inventory is withdrawn, and the busy-reason vocabulary and snapshot fields stay absent without consent. That is test-only evidence of fail-closed intent.

No concrete regression was identified from the supplied evidence. Open integration questions: (1) the production implementation (ProviderLoop+AutopilotPlacement, busy-reason computation, TransitionWatchdog) is not in this batch, so whether adoption can bypass the model_not_selected/consent checks cannot be verified. (2) The `detail` field in autopilotHistory and the busy-reason snapshot are exposed to the coordinator only under consent, and replayed commands return recorded details. The sensitivity of those strings (only enum raw values per the tests) should be confirmed in the production code. (3) Adopted inventory continues to serve after the lease ends. That relates to the model-weight and attestation trust assumptions (T-027, TB-007), and the real gating in serving paths such as throwIfRefusingNewLocalWork needs to be checked by the pass that sees the source. This is not a finding here.
